items.title: Show HN: Outis – Fight AI spam by sending fake "user unknown" bounce emails
items.contentSnippet:
Outis fights spam generating and sending a fake "user unknown" bounce for an email you received, so the sender believes your address does not exist.
Of course this isn't a novel idea, I created a similar program back in 1998–1999 (actually, with a slightly different purpose), but I decided to revive it because it should work quite well with the recent trend of automated emails generated by AI, where the sender might expect a reply; it helps remove your email address from their list.

items.title: Show HN: dishlist – an iPhone app for foodie founders near Dogpatch
items.contentSnippet:
I made dishlist, an iPhone app that is available in the App Store. It is a restaurant recommendation app, like Yelp and Beli. It is different because it is built around things on the menu. Playlists let us organize our favorite songs. What if we did that with our favorite things on the menu?

items.title: Show HN: Game where you control a swarm
items.contentSnippet:
Why I thought this might be interesting for HN – there is a dynamic-code-insertion feature. When you reach 2000 units, you will get an input field where you can describe whatever behavior or command for your swarm and an LLM will create a code that will perform it. Can be something as simple as ‘make a heart’ or more complex, like ‘turn blue when enemies are nearby’. Or describing some kiting strategies.
More of an early demo, but I'm curious what people think about the concept.
